description: How TmChart presents its tooltip: one card per hovered point (the pre-existing behaviour), or one crosshair card per CATEGORY that lists every series at that index and is reachable from the keyboard.

members.name: Point
members.description: One tooltip per hovered point, bar or slice. The default, so a chart that never sets TooltipMode renders exactly what it rendered before the mode existed.

members.name: Index
members.description: A crosshair tooltip: the plot is divided into one full-height hover zone per category, a vertical crosshair marks the active category and the card lists every visible series at that index (color dot, series label, value). The chart becomes one tab stop: the arrow keys walk the indices, Home/End jump to the first and last one, Escape hides the card, and one polite live region announces the whole index. Honoured by Line, Area, Bar, StackedBar and StackedArea; every other chart type falls back to Point rather than rendering half a crosshair.
